title: Shared-code gated admin access + admin permission management (frontend)

requirements.summary: Add a shared-code gate for all /admin routes, persisting verification only for the browser session and clearing on sign out.
acceptanceCriteria: When a signed-in admin visits /admin (or any /admin/* route) without having entered the shared code in the current session, they are blocked and shown a code-entry screen instead of the admin layout.
After entering the correct shared code once, the user can navigate across all /admin pages during that browser session without being prompted again.
If the code is incorrect, the user remains blocked and receives a clear error message in English.
If the user signs out, any stored admin-code verification state is cleared and the user must re-enter the shared code after signing back in.

file_operations.description: Add a small sessionStorage-backed utility for reading/writing/clearing the admin shared-code verification flag for the current browser session (do not store the shared code itself).

Create React Query hooks that call backend capabilities to (a) check whether the current caller has a valid shared-code marker and (b) submit a code for verification using existing actor methods (hasValidAdminSharedCode, verifyAdminSharedCode / retryVerifyAdminSharedCode). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Implement a code-entry screen shown to admins when shared-code verification is missing/expired; on success, persist a session-only verified flag and allow admin rendering; on failure, show a clear English error message. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Extend the existing admin route guard to include the shared-code gate after authentication + admin permission checks: if signed in and admin but no valid shared-code marker for the current session, render AdminSharedCodeGateScreen and do not render children (AdminLayout/sidebar) until verification succeeds.

On logout, clear React Query cache (already done) and also clear any session-only shared-code verification state so the user must re-enter the shared code after signing back in. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add an Admin "Access" management page in /admin to grant/revoke admin access for other accounts (behind admin + shared-code gate).
acceptanceCriteria: A new Admin section/page exists in the /admin area for managing admin access (grant/revoke).
The page provides a way to add an admin by entering a Principal text value (and optionally selecting from a list of known users if available), and to revoke admin from an existing admin.
All grant/revoke actions call backend admin-only APIs and show success/error feedback in English.
Only a caller that is an admin AND has a valid shared-code session can access and use this page; otherwise they are blocked by the same shared-code gate/admin guard behavior as other admin pages.

file_operations.description: Add React Query hooks to list current admin principals and to grant/revoke admin access via existing actor methods (listAdminUsers, grantAdminAccess, revokeAdminAccess), with cache invalidation and English success/error feedback. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create the /admin access management UI: show current admins, provide a Principal text input to grant admin, and revoke controls per admin; display English feedback for success/failure. This page relies on AdminRouteGuard for auth/admin/shared-code gating.
Add an "Access" navigation item in the admin sidebar pointing to /admin/access (keep existing sections intact).
Register the new /admin/access route under the existing /admin route tree so it is reachable via navigation and direct URL.

requirements.summary: Update admin route protection to preserve Internet Identity login and admin permission checks while adding the shared-code verification step before rendering AdminLayout.
acceptanceCriteria: If the user is not signed in, admin routes still show the existing "Authentication Required" state.
If the user is signed in but is not an admin, admin routes still show the existing "Access Denied" state.

If the user is signed in and is an admin, but has not completed shared-code verification (or it expired), the UI prompts for the shared code and does not render the AdminLayout/sidebar content until verification succeeds.
After successful shared-code verification, the AdminLayout renders normally and existing admin pages remain functional.

file_operations.description: Refactor the guard flow to explicitly sequence: (1) Internet Identity authenticated check, (2) admin permission check, (3) shared-code session marker check/prompt, ensuring the existing "Authentication Required" and "Access Denied" screens remain unchanged and all admin pages continue to render once verified.
Ensure AdminLayout remains wrapped by AdminRouteGuard so the sidebar/layout never renders until shared-code verification has succeeded (no additional public routes added).
